reviews.review: I was quite surprised that this game was out I was not aware of the early access. But I'm quite happy I discovered it now. It seems very easy to get into. I've not tried multiplayer just yet or the higher difficulties. I hope there is more variation of the maps. But I'm still very early in the game. The general look and style is very good and the flight control system  is quite comfortable and not awkward at all. the pace of battle is decent and there is a certain mix of free aim and auto tracking of targets which I like. You are not bogged down too much by endless options of customisation. You can just pick up and play and that makes it very accessible. But that not to say there isn't a degree of strategy involved as you progress as this is a squad based game  and gets more difficult as you advance. Anyway I'm enjoying it so far.

Well, well, not even three months in early access and they abandon ship due to poor sales.
VOIDCRISIS is too slow and boring for a third person mecha shooter.
The game still have decent graphics and visual style though.

They should have improved combat and made the gameplay more fast paced.
Right now it feels clunky, unresponsive and way too limited for boost, movements and skills.
Lot of cheap instant death mechanics during boss fights, braindead AI that don't really protect the core.
If you fail a mission that means you have to restart from the very first mission and rebuy mechs each times ?
No I'm good ♥♥♥♥ this game.

Another crap game by HEXADRIVE, probably can be fun if played in coop but absolutely terrible for solo play.
[h1]Rating 2.5/10.[/h1]
